name: City of Los Angeles
disclaimer: LA has complex zoning overlays, specific plans, and hillside requirements. Verify with LADBS and LADCP. Rules vary significantly by neighborhood.

notes: LA has many overlay zones (Historic Preservation Overlay Zones — HPOZs) that may add design review.
Hillside areas have additional grading, access, and setback requirements.
Fire Zone 4 applies to many hillside properties — Class A roofing and ignition-resistant materials required.
Some specific plans (Venice, Hollywood, etc.) may have additional ADU standards.
LA City ADU Ordinance (Ord. 186,481) is the primary ADU document.
Garage conversions in LA are very common and streamlined.
Pre-approved ADU plans available through LADBS.
